findings.title: Missing Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: Missing HTTP Security Header: 'Content-Security-Policy'. Mitigates Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Implement a robust Content-Security-Policy header restricting script execution sources.

findings.title: Missing Header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.detail: Missing HTTP Security Header: 'Strict-Transport-Security'. Enforces secure HTTPS connections.

findings.title: Missing Header: X-Frame-Options
findings.detail: Missing HTTP Security Header: 'X-Frame-Options'. Protects application against Clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing Header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: Missing HTTP Security Header: 'X-Content-Type-Options'. Prevents browser MIME-sniffing vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Missing Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Missing HTTP Security Header: 'Referrer-Policy'. Controls referrer information disclosure in request headers.
